Rhea: Quick thread for the 'DP Velocity Commitment' approach we're proposing for the next roadmap slot. Core ask: run short, focused design-partner sprints (21 week cycles) where partners commit to a "velocity" metric (number of iterations/feature requests validated). Need recruiting filters, what we can promise, must-have telemetry, rollout/rollback, and a tight success rubric. Thoughts? :fire:
Noah: Love it. Suggest recruiting teams who already iterate weekly on ML features (has a PM + eng owner). They should be able to dedicate ~3 engineer-hours/week to the pilot. Target: 6 partners, 2-week sprint, optional repeat. Avoid highly regulated verticals this first pass.
Samir: From ops: hosted + VPC only. Require per-org model pinning, per-route feature flags, and an `iteration_id` in telemetry so we can attribute changes. Need `cache_hit_rate`, `fallback_count`, `batch_size`, `duration_ms`, `quality_score` in logs. Also ask for expected median prompt length to help cache/kv sizing.
Claire: Feedback loop idea: each partner provides a prioritized backlog of 6-8 small experiments. We run 2 per week. Partners must provide a 20-example golden set + 5 labeled failure cases per experiment so we can auto-eval. We'll surface a weekly "iteration report" showing win/loss per experiment and suggested next steps.
Gus: Incentives: $600 credits + co-marketing case study (if partner agrees) + a compact technical report with concrete perf/cost impact per experiment. Screening: legal OK to sign 1-page pilot addendum and allow anonymized telemetry. Include an opt-in checkbox for co-marketing.
Rhea: Minimal promises to partners: we can commit to quick rollouts for small config changes (model variant, batching toggle, token cap tweak), a telemetry dashboard, nightly automated evals for the experiment sets, and a rollback that flips experiment off within 2 minutes if health checks fail. No promises on kernel/driver work, new quant formats, or host-level infra changes.
Noah: Rollback safety: per-route feature flag + automated health-checks. Health-check triggers: p95 latency increase >25%, error_rate absolute +1% or quality_score drop >5 points. When triggered we auto-flip and create a ticket + ping partner and #oncall. We should also snapshot baseline metrics before each experiment (store as `baseline_iteration_<id>`).
Samir: Intake form snippet we should publish (minimal fields):
```
- org_name
- contact_name / email
- product_owner
- commit_capacity_hours_per_week
- expected_peak_qps
- median_prompt_tokens
- can_share_prompts (yes/no)
- legal_ready (yes/no)
- preferred_deploy (hosted/vpc)
- opt_in_comarketing (yes/no)
- desired_start_week
```
Claire: Success rubric (tight):
- Activation: >=75% of partners run at least 1 experiment within first 72 hours
- Iteration velocity: average >=2 validated experiments per week across partners
- Quality guardrail: <=15% partners experience a >5% drop on baseline eval for any experiment
- Value signal: >=30% partners report at least one experiment that meaningfully reduces cost or latency (>=10% improvement) or unlocks product value
- Commercial intent: >=25% indicate desire to continue or ask for Dedicated/Private follow-up
Gus: UX expectation: partner should be able to export per-experiment eval CSV and see a one-page iteration summary within 48 hours of experiment completion. We'll also provide a tiny template for experiment writeups to keep things comparable.
Rhea: Quick negotiation points: we won't accept on-prem for the velocity cohort; partner commit hours are non-negotiable; co-marketing is optional. Also we require a prioritized backlog up front (6-8 small experiments) so we can plan infra work.
Noah: Ops action items: add `iteration_id`, `cache_hit_rate`, `fallback_count` to the telemetry spec, and a health-check snapshot workflow. ETA EOD.
Samir: I'll publish the intake form and include `median_prompt_tokens` and `commit_capacity_hours_per_week`. ETA: forms publish in internal registry.
Claire: I'll draft the experiment template + weekly iteration report deck (ETA: tomorrow AM).
Gus: I'll draft outreach copy and shortlist 9 high-fit candidates; include clear ask to commit 3 engineer-hours/week minimum (ETA: today EOD).
forms-bot: publish: dp-velocity-commitment-intake v1 posted to /internal/dp-forms (status: success)
Rhea: Nice. Tiny add: include a field for `expected_experiment_count` so SRE can estimate load churn. If nobody objects I'll lock these assumptions for the roadmap slide. :white_check_mark:
